item.title: GPS is a guess, and what that means for a location-based experience
item.description: A phone's location is not accurate for the first few seconds. Here is why that breaks a geolocated audio experience, and what we do about it.

item.title: Importing a finished script into a location-based experience
item.description: Paste a whole document and get back a set of geofenced zones with your text in them. How it works, and why the AI never touches a word of it.

item.title: Letting an AI character decide when to unlock a zone
item.description: Our first version opened the locked zone as soon as the character replied to anything. Here is what we changed, and why counting messages was not the fix.
